title: com.ottoyard.directive.ack (operator to OTTO-Q)
description: The operator's answer to one version of one directive. accepted means it will be carried out; rejected means the operator chose not to; unable means it could not. Anything but accepted carries a reason from the closed list, and OTTO-Q re-plans on it; 'other' also carries detail. No ack by the directive's ack_deadline reads as not done.

allOf.description: Anything but accepted names its reason; accepted names none.
'other' says what happened: it is the reason a person reads, and the one that grows the list.
